about: Globals that an approved Stage 3H0 extraction adds on purpose. The client golden harness keeps them out of the strict trace and reports them on their own; any other new or missing global fails the comparison.

why.__mpLib: H0-2 / H0-3: the namespace of the helper scripts cut out of mp.js (assets/net-wire.js -> __mpLib.wire, assets/net-interp.js -> __mpLib.interp). Read by mp.js once at start-up; nothing else uses it.
